repository.scope: The isolated exact-mu standard-QUMOND Cassini quadrupole implementation, warning-strict tests, observed output, README, and input manifest. No direct AQUAL or relativistic-action result is included.

command: Run test_exact_mu_qumond_cassini.py and exact_mu_qumond_cassini.py with PYTHONWARNINGS=error using Python 3.9.6, NumPy 1.26.2, and SciPy 1.11.4.

mathematics.assertion_tested: Whether the standard-QUMOND external-field quadrupole generated by the exact physical interpolation law mu(g/a0)=1-exp(-g/a0) exceeds the adopted Cassini two-sigma ceiling under the recorded Solar and Galactic inputs.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: x=g_N/a0>=0; y=g/a0>=0; true external eta=g_ext/a0 is recomputed for both repository footings (2.47812943953685 and 2.05691993971097); radial integral is truncated at v=6 with a rigorous analytic tail bound and independently scanned to v=10.
mathematics.conventions: x=y mu(y); nu_exact(x)=y/x; e_N=eta mu(eta); q is the dimensionless Q_zz coefficient; |Q2|=(3/2)a0^(3/2)|q|/sqrt(GM_sun).
inputs: Park central Q2=1.6e-27 s^-2 and sigma=1.8e-27 s^-2
The standard QUMOND external-field double integral printed in README.md
exact_results: The inverse round trip closes with maximum relative residual 2.206126e-16 on the tested grid.
Independent split Gauss-Legendre quadrature at order 256 gives q=0.165855042502764.
The absolute tail bound above v=6 is 8.698093e-14.
The nu=1 and eta=0 mutations both return q=0.
At alternate a0, adaptive q=0.165430921606774 and independent split-order-256 q=0.165430921677366.
Q2=1.956185874272e-26 and 2.580227657819e-26 s^-2, respectively 3.761895912 and 4.961976265 times the adopted ceiling.
non_claims: This is not a direct nonlinear AQUAL calculation.
This is not a relativistic-action or PPN no-go theorem.
This does not likelihood-marginalize the Galactic external-field uncertainty.
A different external-field prescription or screened Solar branch is outside this certificate.

literature.search_method: The certificate reproduces the repository's standard DHF/QUMOND convention and records the observational ceiling as an input; no novelty claim is made.
literature.scope_result: Numerical convergence is audited here; source provenance for the adopted observational likelihood remains in the parent repository.

verification.test_status: The warning-strict unittest and main certificate exited 0; fresh stdout matched the recorded output byte for byte.

checks: Invert the exact physical mu law rather than substituting the historical Route-A shortcut.
Promote every adaptive integration warning to an exception.
Compare nested adaptive and shell-split fixed-order quadratures.
Scan fixed orders 32, 64, 128, and 256 and radial endpoints 6 and 10.
Bound the infinite radial tail analytically.
Apply nu=1 and eta=0 mutation controls.
Convert q to Q2 with the explicit 3/2 tensor convention.
result: STANDARD EXACT-MU QUMOND EXCLUDED UNDER BOTH RECORDED a0 FOOTINGS: Q2 IS 3.761895912 AND 4.961976265 TIMES THE ADOPTED TWO-SIGMA CEILING.
next_unavoidable_calculation: For the action-derived AQUAL branch, replace calibrated QUMOND-to-AQUAL rescaling by a direct nonlinear AQUAL convergence certificate with singular-field subtraction, flux/Robin boundaries, nested grids, plateau extraction, and independent solver cross-check.
residual_risks: The direct AQUAL pilot is adverse but still fit-window and inner-boundary sensitive.
The observational and Galactic external-field inputs have not been likelihood-marginalized here.
QUMOND exclusion does not automatically exclude a distinct relativistic AQUAL completion.
